requirements.requirement: The system must define a TypeScript interface for prescription behavior data including prescribing patterns, condition mappings, and score contribution fields.
The system must ensure the schema supports multiple prescribing pattern entries per provider.
The system must define condition mapping fields that associate prescription data with human-readable condition labels.
The system must include a field representing the prescription behavior score contribution to the overall provider quality score.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with structured content rendering expectations of MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must define all required and optional fields explicitly in the TypeScript interface.
The system must allow partial data objects where some prescription fields are missing without breaking the schema contract.
The system must define data types that align with backend outputs from EVAL-P-RX and PIPE-RX-INGEST.
The system must include a version or schema identifier to support future backward-compatible changes.
The system must validate that numeric fields such as score contribution are typed as numbers and not strings.
The system must define a fallback-safe structure that allows rendering logic to skip invalid or empty prescription data objects.
The system must handle the exception where backend data does not match the schema by enforcing type guards or validation checks.
The system must handle the exception where condition mappings are missing by allowing an empty or default condition label field.
